description: Manage conditional text (Window > Type & Tables > Conditional Text): create, change and delete conditions and their indicators, show or hide all, show, hide or print indicators, load conditions and sets from another document, and create, redefine, activate and delete condition sets.

filePath.description: load: an InDesign document to load conditions from

includeSets.description: load: also load its condition sets

indicators.description: set_indicators: show, hide, or show and print the indicators

name.description: The condition (create, edit, delete) or condition set (*_set actions)

indicatorColor.description: Indicator colour: An InDesign UI colour name (e.g. LIGHT_BLUE, RED, GRID_GREEN) or "#RRGGBB"

indicatorMethod.description: Indicate the text with a highlight or an underline

underlineAppearance.description: Underline style when indicating with an underline

replaceWith.description: delete: give the deleted condition's text this condition instead of none

visibility.description: create_set, redefine_set: condition visibility to record in the set; other conditions keep their current visibility

name: manage_conditions
title: Manage Conditions
